instructions:
1. Stand about 60 cm in front of a bench, facing away from it.
2. Place the top of your left foot on the bench behind you. Keep your right foot flat on the floor.
3. Bend your right knee and hip to lower your body, keeping your torso upright, until your right thigh is parallel to the floor.
4. Drive through your right heel to stand back up.
5. Finish the set, then switch legs.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your front knee tracking over your toes.
2. Place most of your weight on the front foot, not the rear.
3. Inhale as you lower, exhale as you drive up.
4. Move the front foot farther from the bench to shift load to the glutes.
name: Bulgarian split squat bodyweight right

instructions:
1. Stand in front of a bench, facing away from it. Place the band under your front foot.
2. Set the top of your rear foot on the bench behind you.
3. Hold the band handles near your shoulders with palms facing forward.
4. Bend your front knee to lower your body until your back knee is just above the floor.
5. Drive through your front heel to stand back up, then switch legs after the set.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your torso upright throughout the movement.
2. Track your front knee over your toes.
3. Exhale as you push up, inhale as you lower.
4. Keep tension on the band so it stays under the front foot.
name: Bulgarian split squat cable Resistance band

instructions:
1. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, arms at your sides.
2. Squat down and place your hands on the floor in front of you.
3. Jump your feet back into a plank, keeping your body in a straight line.
4. Lower into a push-up, then push back up.
5. Jump your feet back to your hands, then jump straight up with arms overhead.
6. Land softly, drop back into the squat, and repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your hips level in the plank, do not let them sag.
2. Land softly with bent knees to absorb impact.
3. Brace your core through every transition.
4. Set a steady pace you can hold with good form.
name: Burpee
